title: Aquatic cinematic v2 portrait living habitat

constraints.character: Recognizable modest-scale striped freshwater angelfish within a living habitat; coherent bodies, eyes and complete fins, with natural turns and genuine forward propulsion. Position may change.
constraints.materials: Realistic fish scales and fine fins, natural plant leaves and wood grain; no morphing or melting background geometry.
constraints.lighting: Stable soft underwater daylight, subtle current-driven shimmer, quiet shaded live-UI areas; no flash, exposure pumping or artificial neon.
constraints.camera: One continuous steady underwater environmental view; no cuts, zoom, shake or forced reframing.
constraints.motion: Visible slow natural swimming, tail/fin propulsion, depth-appropriate occlusion and gently moving leaves. No hovering-only brief, reference-position lock, reverse motion, forced opening-pose return or held-frame stretch.
constraints.environment: Independently composed full portrait habitat; fish in central upper-middle swimming space, protected top navigation and shaded lower live-copy areas. No edge-clipped mascot.

acceptance.criterion: Full raw shot decodes; native dimensions, actual FPS/duration, audio absence, source hash and actual cost recorded honestly.
Complete normal-speed playback shows actual forward swimming, believable propulsion/anatomy, stable habitat and natural depth.
At least three repeated runtime joins show no distracting jump, flash, double fish or reverse/held movement. Failure blocks integration.
Main fish framing and quiet live-copy zones survive actual desktop/phone/near-square/landscape crops throughout the take.

Record technical checks, coordinator visual judgment and human acceptance separately. After standalone technical and coordinator visual gates pass, authorized implementation may proceed; human acceptance remains pending unless explicitly provided.
